visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Walk a Pointer to the End
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A for loop with a break and a counter measures the string. Write a length function that moves a pointer to the terminator and subtracts the start. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Subtracting two pointers into the same array gives the number of elements between them. The made-up limit 100 disappears, so strings of any length work.
